step.title: Start Postgres and Redis
step.text: Redis is the storage behind Hermes, the invoicing queue.
step.if_fails: Paste the error text below to find a fix.

fix.why: Postgres is not running, or another Postgres already uses port 5432.
fix.fix: run `docker compose up -d` and check `docker compose ps`. If port 5432 is taken by a local Postgres, stop it (`brew services stop postgresql` or `sudo systemctl stop postgresql`) or change the port in `docker-compose.yml` and `DATABASE_URL`.
